children: Brand–new Oakridge Elite model home now open for tours
CUMMING, Ga., Sept. 02, 2026
, the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, today announced the highly anticipated opening of its new model home at

params.linkText: Toll Brothers at the Crossing at Coal Mountain

children: in Cumming, Georgia. Home shoppers are now invited to tour this professionally decorated model townhome, which highlights the exceptional craftsmanship and timeless architectural designs for which Toll Brothers is known, at 4280 Waylon Drive in Cumming.

The Oakridge Elite with Loft model home, part of the Haven Collection, is a spacious 3-story townhome design featuring 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a 2-car garage. This thoughtfully designed home offers open-concept living spaces, a luxurious primary bedroom suite, and a versatile loft that can be customized to suit a variety of lifestyle needs. Priced from the low $500,000s, homes in the Haven collection provide a perfect balance of style, functionality, and modern elegance.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at The Crossing at Coal Mountain

children: "We are excited to unveil our new model home, which embodies the seamless blend of luxury and convenience that Toll Brothers delivers at this community," said Eric White, Division President of Toll Brothers in Georgia. "This new model home provides home shoppers with a firsthand look at the exceptional quality and design that defines our homes at Toll Brothers at the Crossing at Coal Mountain."
Toll Brothers at the Crossing at Coal Mountain is a vibrant master-planned community offering a variety of single-family homes and townhome designs across four distinct collections.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at The Crossing at Coal Mountain

children: Residents will enjoy an array of future resort-style amenities, including a 3,814-square-foot pool, pickleball courts, an event lawn, walking trails, and more.

The community’s prime location in Forsyth County provides convenient access to top-rated schools, local shopping and dining at Cumming City Center, and major thoroughfares like Georgia State Route 400.
Future dining, shopping, and entertainment are also slated for Coal Mountain Town Center and will be walkable from the community.

Toll Brothers customers will experience one-stop shopping at the Toll Brothers Design Studio. The state-of-the-art Design Studio allows home shoppers to choose from a wide array of selections to personalize their dream home with the assistance of Toll Brothers professional Design Consultants.

image.alt: Toll Brothers at The Crossing at Coal Mountain

children: For more information on Toll Brothers communities throughout Georgia and to schedule a tour of the new model home at the Crossing at Coal Mountain, call 888-686-5542 or visit TollBrothers.com/GA.
About Toll Brothers

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "TOL." Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list of the World's Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
